measure.name: create_necb_archetype
measure.description: Creates a Canadian NECB prototype using bundled public geometry, weather and nrcan_nrc standards. Replaces the current model after successful local sizing. No OpenStudio Server required.
measure.modeler_description: Adapted from NRC nrc_create_necb_prototype_building. Uses Standard.build and model_create_prototype_model in an isolated local CLI process. All extra library files are under resources. Supports OpenStudio 3.11 / Application 1.11.1.

argument.name: custom_epw_path
argument.display_name: Optional local EPW path (matching DDY and STAT required)
